name: snitch
description: Catches coding agents that make tests pass by cheating, and gives them an honest way out.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe: record only. warn: tell the agent and you, never block. enforce: also block edits to frozen tests and stops that hide test changes.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: on: before warning about an undisclosed test change, ask Claude (claude -p, your own login) whether your request asked for it; a legitimate change is not flagged. Slower stops. Default off.
